plain.s: The seat map opened with a valid reference and the booking succeeded: booking reference OODZPW, ticket 722137003972
plain.x: The booking should be accepted and return its booking reference and ticket details
plain.a: Confirmed — the seat map's reference was accepted by the booking step, which issued a real ticket (the earlier booking-error defect BUG-16 did not appear)

title: Validate a cellID obtained from one offer's GetSeatMap response is rejected when submitted in Book for a different offer.
endpoint_or_flow: Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> GetSeatMap (x2 offers) -> Book
request_summary: Book on offer E2 (BAH-JED 2027-06-25) with seat cellCode 8C but cellId = the cellID issued for seat 8A on a different offer E1 (BAH-JED 2027-06-24); two independent Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> GetSeatMap chains
response_summary: 200 - pnr THWPTO ticketed (722137003973) after 28.8s; passengersSelectedSeats came back empty; totalSelectedSeatsAmount 0; no error
expected: Request is rejected with a 4xx validation error (exact shape UNKNOWN per 7.9) because the cellID embeds the originating ResponseId/OfferId and is bound to the offer it was issued for
actual: STILL REPRODUCES (BUG-07, 14th confirmed occurrence, not new). The foreign cellId was not rejected: Book ran the full supplier round-trip, created and ticketed a real booking, and silently dropped the seat (empty passengersSelectedSeats, no seat fee) instead of returning an error. Seat 8C was neither attached nor refused. Same-round VAL-03 shows a valid same-offer cellId does attach (BUG-19 gone), so the foreign token is detected as not matching but swallowed rather than rejected.
evidence: Book 200 in 28776 ms; pnr THWPTO, ticket 722137003973; passengersSelectedSeats empty; totalSelectedSeatsAmount 0 SAR; E1 and E2 had different responseId/offerId

plain.e: Confirm a seat code taken from one flight offer is refused when used on a different offer
plain.q: Opened seat maps for two separate offers (Bahrain to Jeddah, 24 and 25 June 2027), then booked on the second offer with seat 8C but using the seat code copied from the first offer's seat 8A
plain.s: The booking was accepted: reference THWPTO, ticket 722137003973, but no seat was attached and no seat charge was made
plain.x: The booking should have been refused straight away, because the seat code belongs to another offer
plain.a: BUG-07, 14th confirmed occurrence (not new) — the foreign seat code was not rejected; a real ticket was issued and the requested seat was silently dropped without any error

title: Verify cellAvailability/paxCellAvailability values are limited to AvailablePaid, Blocked, and Occupied, and that Aisle-category cells carry no seatPriceDetails.
request_summary: Two GetSeatMap responses enumerated cell by cell: chain A (BAH-RUH 2027-06-24, GF161, 1 ADT, 210 cells) and chain B (BAH-DMM 2027-06-25, GF103, ADT+CHD, 140 cells)
response_summary: 200 both - cellCategory: Seat 298, Aisle 50, NoSeat 2; cellAvailability: AvailablePaid 298; paxCellAvailability: AvailablePaid 416, AvailableFree 2; no Blocked or Occupied; Aisle cells with cellDetails/price: 0
expected: Every cellCategory is Seat or Aisle; every cellAvailability/paxCellAvailability is AvailablePaid, Blocked or Occupied; a new value is logged and flagged, not hard-failed (8.3 policy); Aisle cells carry no seatPriceDetails
actual: Passed with two flags, as in Round 18 (flagged, not failed, per the 8.3 policy). No Blocked or Occupied value appeared anywhere on this airline. Two values outside the expected sets were seen: cellCategory "NoSeat" (2 cells on chain A - a taken/absent seat, cellDetails null) and paxCellAvailability "AvailableFree" (seat 8E, the bassinet seat on the A320 flight GF103, for both passengers at 0.00 SAR while the overall cellAvailability stays AvailablePaid). All 50 Aisle cells have cellDetails null, so none carries a price (0 violations). Unchanged from Round 18.
evidence: Chain A: cellCategory Seat 178 / Aisle 30 / NoSeat 2; cellAvailability AvailablePaid 178; paxCellAvailability AvailablePaid 178. Chain B: Seat 120 / Aisle 20; cellAvailability AvailablePaid 120; paxCellAvailability AvailablePaid 238 + AvailableFree 2 (8E PAX1 total 0, 8E PAX2 total 0). Aisle cells with cellDetails: 0 of 50.

plain.e: Confirm the seat availability values are limited to the known set and that walkways carry no prices
plain.q: Read two live seat maps (Bahrain to Riyadh with one adult; Bahrain to Dammam with an adult and a child) and listed each distinct availability and cell-type value
plain.s: Only "paid" seats are reported as available; two taken seats show as an empty "no seat" cell; one bassinet seat is free for each passenger (2 entries); walkways have no price
plain.x: Only the known availability values should appear, and walkway cells should have no price; anything new is logged, not failed
plain.a: No blocked or occupied seats appear on this airline. Two new values are flagged, not failed: the "no seat" cell type for taken seats and a free per-passenger bassinet seat

text: Run note (Real Clock Experiment): every timestamp in this log is a live clock read taken when the event happened - each call's start/end, each test case's start/verdict, and each test case's own report-write window (append to the log + re-render of the .md, 85-98 ms each, written before the next test case started). The end stamp of a report-write window is only known after the render, so that one field is patched into the line in place right after the render (the .md is then re-rendered once more). Flights: all six chains used fresh dates (24-26 June 2027) and never reused a flight+date from earlier logs, except VAL-04's offer E2 (BAH-JED 2027-06-25, GF181), which had been used in an earlier round. Each test case ran its own chains (no shared seat maps), so BND-02 used 2 maps, BIZ-02 1 (ADT+CHD), REG-02 1. Every GulfAir seat on the VAL-03 flight (179 of 179) carries a fee, unlike Round 16.
